medium: A smoothly painted surreal interior where one existing background plane opens into a calm impossible sky.
composition: Preserve observed furniture and viewpoint; transform only one clearly bounded wall or window plane into sky.
texture: Use smooth precise oil-like painting and clean material edges, without torn collage seams or double-exposure transparency.
palette: Keep source object colors and introduce restrained sky blues or warm cloud whites only within the transformed plane.
lighting: Maintain coherent source-side lighting on furniture; the impossible opening may cast one restrained compatible ambient tint.
detail: Keep objects solid, supports connected and openings readable; add no floating people, duplicate furniture or unrelated symbolic props.
finish: Deliver one finished image at the input aspect ratio, without comparison panels, unrequested text, logos, signatures or watermarks.

Keep the entire surrounding wall its original cream color. Do not make sky wallpaper. Preserve the panel rectangle edges and all room objects. A quiet smoothly painted surreal artwork with an actual bounded sky opening.

review.reason: The large panel alone becomes a deep sky plane with distant clouds; the surrounding wall remains cream. Chair, lamp, table, book, plant and connected supports remain in place with coherent light, without collage seams or duplicate furniture.
